name: canvas-reviewer
description: HTML5 Canvas code quality reviewer. Use when reviewing game loop code, checking render performance, or validating canvas drawing patterns in any browser-based game project.
welcomeMessage: Canvas Reviewer ready — read-only mode. I'll audit your canvas code for ctx.save()/restore() pairing, render-loop allocations, shadowBlur resets, draw order, and performance issues. No files will be modified.
